title: Gluing classicality through a finite stratification
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be an arbitrary commutative ring, S a finite constructible locally closed scheme stratification of X, and F a pro-etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules. Suppose for every stratum immersion i_k:S_k$\to$X the sheaf i_k^*F belongs to the essential image of $\nu$_{S_k}^*. Then F belongs to the essential image of $\nu$_X^*. No finite stalk hypothesis is imposed. Stratifications are as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and comparison is [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: Classicality is Zariski local. Place F in degree zero, apply the existing derived open-cover counit criterion to the local etale single-degree origins, and take zeroth homology. The derived direct image of a sheaf in degree zero is bounded below; exact comparison commutes with homology. The criterion uses derived full faithfulness [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison].

Induct on the number n of strata for all schemes. At each point choose its stratum and an affine neighborhood V where it is closed with quasi-compact open complement, using [lem-sf-constructible-partition-local-closed-stratum]. Pull S back to V, then to the complement U. Pullback compatibility [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] preserves classicality of every restricted stratum. The selected stratum is empty over U; delete its index using Fin.succAbove, leaving n-1 strata, and apply induction. For n=0 there are no base points; the empty open-cover argument applies.

The selected immersion into V has closed range, hence is a closed immersion. Apply [lem-sf-proetale-open-closed-sequence]. Both end terms are classical: extension by zero commutes with comparison by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], and closed direct image commutes with underived comparison by the existing lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange theorem for qcqs morphisms. Classical sheaves are closed under extensions: lift the boundary of the short-exact-sequence triangle through derived full faithfulness [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], compare triangles, and take zeroth homology, as implemented in etaleOrigin_of_shortExact. This proves classicality on V, then globally by the first step. A full-image stratum is handled by the same closed immersion argument.

proof_origin.place: Generalization of the existing compiled argument to arbitrary commutative rings; no new holes. The proof does not require a finite coefficient ring.
